import html
import re

_LABEL = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}\[([^\[\]]+)\]:[ \t]*(.*)$")


def _unescape(value: str) -> str:
    value = html.unescape(value)
    return re.sub(r"\\([!\"#$%&'()*+,\-./:;<=>?@\[\\\]^_`{|}~])", r"\1", value)


def _label(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(value.casefold().strip(" \t\r\n").split())


def extract_definitions(text: str, references: dict) -> str:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offset = 0
    while offset < len(lines):
        current = lines[offset].rstrip("\r\n")
        match = _LABEL.match(current)
        if not match or not match.group(1).strip(" \t"):
            break
        key = _label(match.group(1))
        rest = match.group(2).strip(" \t")
        destination = None
        title = None
        if rest.startswith("<"):
            end = rest.find(">")
            if end > 0 and "\n" not in rest[1:end]:
                destination, tail = rest[1:end], rest[end + 1:].strip(" \t")
            else:
                break
        else:
            dest_match = re.match(r"((?:\\.|[^\s])*)", rest)
            destination = dest_match.group(1) if dest_match else ""
            tail = rest[len(destination):].strip(" \t")
            if destination.count("(") - destination.count(")") > 0:
                break
        if not destination:
            break
        if tail:
            if tail[0] not in "\"'(" or tail[-1] != ({'"': '"', "'": "'", "(": ")"}[tail[0]]):
                break
            title = _unescape(tail[1:-1])
        references.setdefault(key, (_unescape(destination), title))

"""Fenced code block recognition."""

import re

_OPEN = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$")


def parse_fenced_code(lines: list[str]):
    if not lines:
        return None
    match = _OPEN.match(lines[0])
    if not match:
        return None
    fence, info = match.groups()
    if fence[0] == "`" and "`" in info:
        return None
    info = info.strip(" \t")
    indent = len(lines[0]) - len(lines[0].lstrip(" "))
    close = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}" + re.escape(fence[0]) + r"{" + str(len(fence)) + r",}[ \t]*$")
    content = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines[1:], 1):
        if close.match(line):
            return "".join(line[max(indent, 0):] + "\n" for line in content), info, index + 1
        content.append(line)
    return "".join(line[indent:] + "\n" for line in content), info, len(lines)

import re

_BLOCK = set("address article aside base basefont blockquote body caption center col colgroup dd details dialog dir div dl dt fieldset figcaption figure footer form frame frameset h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 head header hr html iframe legend li link main menu menuitem nav noframes ol optgroup option p param search section summary table tbody td tfoot th thead title tr track ul".split())


def _start(line: str):
    text = line[3:] if line.startswith("   ") else line
    if not line.startswith(" ") or len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" ")) <= 3:
        pass
    else:
        return None
    patterns = [
        (1, re.compile(r"<(?:pre|script|style|textarea)(?:[ \t/>]|$)", re.I), re.compile(r"", re.I)),
        (2, re.compile(r"")),
        (3, re.compile(r"<\?"), re.compile(r"\?>")),
        (4, re.compile(r"")),
        (5, re.compile(r"")),
    ]
    for kind, begin, end in patterns:
        if begin.match(text):
            return kind, end
    tag = re.match(r"]*[ \t]*)?/?>[ \t]*$", text)
    if tag and tag.group(1).lower() in _BLOCK:
        return 6, None
    if re.fullmatch(r"]*)?/?>[ \t]*", text):
        return 7, None
    return None


def parse_html_block(lines: list[str], paragraph_open: bool = False):
    if not lines:
        return None
    start = _start(lines[0])
    if not start:
        return None
    kind, end = start
    if kind == 7 and paragraph_open:
        return None
    consumed = 0
    for line in lines:
        if kind >= 6 and not line.strip(" \t"):
            break
        consumed += 1
        if end and end.search(line):
            break
    return "".join(line + "\n" for line in lines[:consumed]), consumed
